GHA.note: Ghana Card integration is for land transactions and in progress; no authentication service stated in service or piloted.
Nothing on civil register and ID links.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs the national ID system.

facts.fact: Dr Benjamin Quaye of the Lands Commission says the Commission is integrating the Ghana Card into its land system for identity-based transactions.

GHA.note: The integration is stated as in progress, not as a register keyed on the number in service.
Nothing on the national ID system's design, biometrics or assurance.

facts.fact: Dr Benjamin Quaye of the Lands Commission says the Enterprise Land Information System provides registration, searches and stamping, and industry players can search online without visiting the Commission.

GHA.note: No joining to survey maps or valuation and no tax link stated; stamping is not described as a tax.

facts.fact: The Lands Commission says its Enterprise Land Information System provides registration and searches, in use now.
Dr Benjamin Quaye says industry players can now conduct land searches online through the Enterprise Land Information System without visiting the Commission.

GHA.note: National coverage is not stated; the QR-coded digital land certificate is only being worked towards.
